advisory.text: Start irrigating this morning: about 22.4 hours of pumping (1120 m³ of water).
Water stress: Moderate (52% chance of moderate or severe stress).
If irrigation is delayed by 5 days, expected yield loss is 1.55% (1.14 t of cane).
Expected cane yield: 100.2 t/ha (73.7 t for this plot).
Fertigation this week: 10.8 kg urea, 2.3 kg 12-61-0 and 4.4 kg potash (2 splits).
Disease and pest risk is low.
